command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '[job] fitter full dependency and parallel symbolic suite\n'
printf '[worker] host=%s os=%s arch=%s cpus=%s memory_bytes=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(uname -s)" "$(uname -m)" "$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)" "$(sysctl -n hw.memsize)"
python3 --version
python3 -m venv .runner-venv-full
. .runner-venv-full/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements.txt
python - <<'PY'
import platform
import numpy
import scipy
import torch
import yaml
import z3
print(f"[python] {platform.python_version()}")
print(f"[numpy] {numpy.__version__}")
print(f"[scipy] {scipy.__version__}")
print(f"[torch] {torch.__version__} mps_built={torch.backends.mps.is_built()} mps_available={torch.backends.mps.is_available()}")
print(f"[pyyaml] {yaml.__version__}")
print(f"[z3] {z3.get_version_string()}")
PY
tests="tests/certification/validate_controller_class_analysis.py tests/certification/validate_mixing_symbolic_machine.py tests/certification/validate_ot_markov_pipeline.py tests/certification/validate_structural_discretization.py tests/certification/validate_structural_markov.py tests/certification/validate_thermostat_symbolic_machine.py"
pids=""
outputs=""
for test_file in $tests
do
  output_file="$(basename "$test_file").out"
  PYTHONPATH=src python "$test_file" -v >"$output_file" 2>&1 &
  pids="$pids $!"
  outputs="$outputs $output_file"
done
status=0
for pid in $pids
do
  wait "$pid" || status=1
done
for output_file in $outputs
do
  printf '[test-output] %s\n' "$output_file"
  cat "$output_file"
done
test "$status" -eq 0
printf '[job] full-deps-parallel-suite-passed\n'
